title: A Lambda function's CloudWatch metrics over a window

periodSeconds.description: The CloudWatch period of each datapoint

invocations.description: Sum of Invocations; 0 with no datapoints; null when the call failed

errors.description: Sum of Errors (invocations that raised, timed out or crashed); null when the call failed

throttles.description: Sum of Throttles; null when the call failed

errorRate.description: errors / invocations; null when there were no invocations or a count is unknown

averageMs.description: Average weighted by each datapoint's sample count

duration.description: null when the Duration call failed

datapoints.description: Datapoints CloudWatch returned per metric; 0 means no data in the window (a function that was not invoked publishes none); null means the call failed

errorRateAboveThreshold.description: errorRate >= the errorRateThreshold setting; null when the numbers were not read

throttlesAboveThreshold.description: throttles >= the throttleThreshold setting; null when not read

durationNearTimeout.description: The longest invocation reached durationTimeoutRatio of the function's timeout; null when not read
